newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam Aug Dai Hung sell tender awarded to Petco.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Aug Dai Hung sell tender awarded to Petco.

text.p: The consortium operating Vietnam's Dai Hung crude field awarded its August sell tender to Malaysian trading company Petco at Minas APPI +52 cents per barrel, traders said on Monday.
The tender, to sell a 400,000 barrel cargo of Dai Hung crude loading in the first half of August, was awarded on Friday.
In the last tender, an end June/early July cargo, was awarded to South Korean refiner LG Caltex at Minas APPI +43.

The equity producers of Dai Hung are Malaysia's state-owned Petronas, with 63.5 percent, Japan's Sumitomo with 10.625 percent, France's Total SA with 10.625 percent and state-owned Petrovietnam with 15 percent.

Petronas announced last week that it had received formal approval from Vietnam to take up The Broken Hill Pty Co. Ltd (BHP) 43.65 percent share in the Dai Hung field, effectively becoming the operator of the field.
Prior to the approval, Petronas had held a 20 percent share in Dai Hung.
